title: [codereview-pass3] project-LICHEN-worker6-tkjl: senml.h has duplicate senml_encode_location_full declaration
description:
CORRECTNESS: senml_encode_location_full is declared twice in senml.h with identical signatures but different doc comments.

Location: lichen/subsys/lichen/senml/include/lichen/senml.h

- First declaration: lines 234-258 (doc comment + declaration)
- Second declaration: lines 260-283 (different doc comment + identical declaration)

While C compilers accept compatible redeclarations, having two declarations is unintended and confusing. The second (more detailed) doc comment should exist on the sole declaration, not be a duplicate.

Fix: merge into a single declaration with the more detailed doc comment (the second one, which includes 'or NAN to omit' per-param notes). Remove the first one.
